aero_spot_plus_alpha_delist.title: Binance Will List Aerodrome Finance (AERO)
aero_spot_plus_alpha_delist.body:
Binance will list Aerodrome Finance (AERO) and open trading for the following spot trading pairs at 2024-10-17 12:00 (UTC):
AERO/USDT
AERO/USDC
AERO/BNB
AERO/FDUSD
AERO/TRY

AERO will be delisted from Binance Alpha when spot trading opens. Alpha users should manage their positions.
